metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 5 easy exercises that are guaranteed to help burn leg and thigh fat.

These exercises can be used together as a workout to tone leg and thigh muscles, and require no equipment. 

Let us know how they work for you!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:36 Inner Thigh
2:46 Glutes (Butt) and Hamstrings
4:52 Dog Hydrant
6:35 Goblet Squat (and Calves)
9:12 Double Lunge
